# Candidate crystals
- Crystal-K3: inorganic scintillator, high light yield, fast decay.
- Crystal-K1: inorganic scintillator, medium light yield.
- Crystal-K2: inorganic scintillator, mature growth process, lower light yield.
All three are available in the required sizes from at least one vendor.

# Earlier simulation summary (2025, nominal 5 cm thickness)
Energy resolution at 662 keV (FWHM): Crystal-K3 2.9%, Crystal-K1 4.5%, Crystal-K2 8.5%.
Thickness dependence was weak in the 3-8 cm range.

# Meeting notes 2026-02-11
Attendees discussed the shielding upgrade (lead + copper, complete) and the schedule for commissioning in Q3. Action: finalise the crystal choice this quarter.

content.text: K3 fails. Compare K1 and K2 across thickness.

input.justification: K3 has the best resolution but its assay result of 2.0 counts/kg/day is four times the 0.5 budget, so it is excluded. K1 (0.3) and K2 (0.1) both pass the background limit. K1 resolves far better than K2 (about 4.6–5.1% against about 8.5% from the 2025 summary). Simulated K1 resolution is flat with thickness within noise, roughly 4.6–5.1% across 2–8 cm. 5 cm gave the lowest value, 4.63%, but the differences between thicknesses are probably not significant. I did not simulate K2 at the new thicknesses, and I did not simulate K1 at 10 cm.
